metadata.description: Allot, a self-hosted money planner: connect your own Allot server to Claude and use its skills.

plugins.name: allot
plugins.description: Connect your self-hosted Allot server over OAuth (sign in and consent in Allot) and get seven money skills: month start, payday, month end, subscriptions, receipts, spending plan, assets.

plugins.name: allot-key
plugins.description: The same Allot skills, connected with an Allot API key instead of OAuth (for a server on a private network, or when OAuth is off).
